inputs.name: ProjectRunService.run.context
inputs.description: The creation run's context before anything is planned: the run id, project root, revision, runner, abort signal, emit callback, request, preparation, project session and mutable project. The run asks the runner once, read-only, and plans nothing if the signal is aborted before planning starts or the source revision advanced during the run.

outputs.name: plannedBefore
outputs.description: An exported module-level WeakMap that maps the Error a failed or cancelled run rejects with to a copy of the CreatedEntity of the draft that run had already created. It is set only when a draft existed before that error, and setting it never removes the draft.

outputs.name: ProjectRunService.run
outputs.description: The resolved result of a creation run: a summary naming the proposal title and the saved design version, and the created entity naming the new plan and its thread. It resolves only after the design version is saved; a run that fails or is cancelled rejects instead.

examples.summary: Planned Evidence grid. Saved v001 for review.
Planned Status pill. Saved v001 for review.
Planned Order export. Saved v001 for review.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when the source revision advanced during the run, when the agent changed files although it was asked not to, or when its answer is not a checked proposal. An agent failure is rethrown unchanged, or as an Error that also names the files it changed, and a failure of a planning step is rethrown unchanged.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown when the run's signal is aborted at one of its checks: after the agent answers, before planning starts, while design options are generated, or before the design version is saved. A cancellation reported by the agent's run is passed on unchanged; the error is an Error whose name is RunCancelled, and a draft created before it is kept and copied into plannedBefore.
